name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task unconditionally commands 'Carry the box to the exit', so reaching the exit with the box is a hard goal, but the candidate only has Response(at_exit, holding_box), which is a rule that requires nothing (it holds if at_exit never happens). The machine's FINAL_STATES is empty. Add a hard Existence(at_exit); keep Response(at_exit, holding_box) so the box is held when the exit is reached, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) for the pickup rule.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) with Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires reaching the exit while carrying the box, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up after every fall. All three hard clauses match the task.

texts: carry the box to the exit
carry the box to the exit
whenever the box falls, pick it up again
